query: How do I make English muffin pizzas?

goal.title: Make English muffin pizzas in a toaster oven
goal.description: Toast a split English muffin in a toaster oven, then move the halves to a baking tray. Drizzle them with olive oil, spread on pizza sauce with a spoon, sprinkle shredded cheese, and press on pepperoni slices from a torn-open package. Slide the tray back into the toaster oven, check on it once partway through, and finally retrieve the finished muffin pizzas.
goal.final_state: Both English muffin halves are fully baked into muffin pizzas with melted cheese and pepperoni visible, removed from the toaster oven on their tray.
procedure: Place the split English muffin in the toaster oven and toast it.
Remove the halves and arrange them on a baking tray.
Drizzle oil over the muffin halves and fetch a spoon.
Spread pizza sauce and shredded cheese over both halves.
Open the pepperoni package and arrange slices over the cheese.
Put the topped muffin halves back in the toaster oven.
Check the pizzas while they bake and remove the tray.

phases.description: Retrieve an English muffin and place it in the toaster oven, then set the oven going.
Let the muffin toast, then remove the halves from the oven.
Transfer the toasted muffin halves onto a baking tray.
Drizzle olive oil, fetch a spoon, spread pizza sauce, and sprinkle shredded cheese on both muffin halves.
Open a pepperoni package and press pepperoni slices onto both muffin halves.
Carry the assembled muffin pizzas to the toaster oven and start baking.
Bake the muffin pizzas, check on them once, then retrieve the finished pizzas.

notes: All overview and dense contact sheets (3fps typical, denser for sub-1s steps) reviewed; native frames checked at full resolution where sauce/cheese/pepperoni identity was unclear in the thumbnails. Step 46 (132.8-134.64s) old_summary claims pepperoni placement, but full-resolution frames at that time show only shredded cheese on both muffin halves; the pepperoni package is not opened until step 51 (~143s). differs_from_expectation noted on step 46. Steps 67 and 72 (long toaster-oven bake intervals) are re-typed idle; the source labelled them action but no hands are visible for the full interval. Tail after the last step (299.96s to ffprobe duration 300.067s) is 0.107s, under the 1s reporting threshold, so no separate tail note is needed. Dataset duration_in_sec (174.1s) is stale/incorrect; fine steps already span the full ffprobe duration (300.067s) and that is what is used throughout.
